input.scope: complete numeric text, no 000, length 2-14, real CISI ID, exact R/L or L/R metadata
scope_difference_from_20260524_prototype: M-207 is excluded because +892-831 lacks the required closing plus delimiter despite its older readiness label.
H-23 is excluded because its direction field is the malformed case variant R/l rather than an allowed exact direction value.

model.name: micro
model.initialization: random canonical shared body independent of vocabulary size

split.policy: exact sequences, one-edit components, and catalogue objects are disjoint; any component touching a forced pattern is entirely held out

forced_hypothesis_test.interpretation: descriptive only; no matched baseline or multi-seed/control result is available from the local run

secondary_metrics.interpretation: not claim-eligible without the fixed multi-seed learned controls and transfer comparisons

decision: The micro SLM is worse than the bidirectional bigram baseline on ordinary held-out top-1 and top-5 restoration. The local run validates the instrument but adds no structural finding and cannot support a reading, sign value, meaning, or language claim.
